messages:
rory: opened a PR to propose a canonical parsing example for function/tool outputs (create_reminder). Adds a JSON Schema, parse-fallback note, and examples in Go + TS. PR: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2080|github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2080>

maya: skimmed the diff. big +1 for explicit schema. nit: example uses "when" as an integer unix timestamp — can we use RFC3339 string instead? avoids timezone confusion. prefer enum for "priority".

sam: sure, swapping to RFC3339 string and enum. i'll add a Go snippet with a typed struct and TS snippet using `as const`.

jordan: CI flagged missing language tags on fenced blocks and a trailing comma in the inline JSON. i'll push a cleanup commit.

alice: ops request: add a one-liner in the runbook for disabling strict schema enforcement during incidents (flag: `schema_enforcement=false`) and how to pin traffic to model v2.1.

rory: added runbook note and rollback snippet; switched "when" -> RFC3339 and priority -> ["low","medium","high"]. branch `rory/reminder-schema-rfc`.

sam: pushed Go + TS snippets. TS example inline: `const createReminderSchema = { type: 'object', properties: { title: {type:'string'}, when: {type:'string', format:'date-time'}, priority: {type:'string', enum:['low','medium','high']} }, required: ['title','when'] } as const; await client.callTool('create_reminder', { schema: createReminderSchema });`

maya: please add one sentence about runtime fallback order: validate -> light coercions (parse RFC3339, numeric casts) -> error. if strict mode enabled, coercions are disabled.

jordan: reworded to: "Runtime parsing order: validate against schema -> attempt ISO8601/RFC3339 parsing of date strings and numeric coercion for integers -> return structured error if still invalid. Strict mode disables coercions." pushed fixes.

docbot: link-checker found 1 broken link (docs/events/old-events.md). suggested fix in `link-sweep-2026`.

rory: cherry-picked link-sweep commit. tests added: docs/tests/validate_fenced_blocks.py extracts fenced JSON and validates against declared schema.

jordan: ran tests locally, CI green on 4823456829, will merge after final maya review.

maya: LGTM, merging and announcing in #docs-updates. :tada:

docbot: ci-bot: all checks passed on 4823456829 — merged and deployed to staging.
